title: Counting calls
prompt: The robot counts ticks in a member `count` that starts at 0, one tick per call of a `tick` helper. count_ticks(3) ticks three times and reports 3.
hints: tick adds 1 to count; count_ticks calls tick n times in a loop, then returns count. The member keeps its value between calls.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: The numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.
